text:
oncall-jordi: Deploybot flagged embeddings p95 surge and suggested auto-rollback. I'm holding auto-revert for now — need ops decision: full rollback vs targeted routing fallback for embeddings route only. Dedicated customers are pinned. Legal change window ends in ~6h. Who can take a quick handoff? :eyes:

alex: Quick sanity check — is it error-rate or latency? If it's just p95 latency, we can route a % to fallback model instead of full rollback.

deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK SUGGESTED — metric=embeddings_p95, threshold=800ms, current=1200ms, action=rollback to v3.1, grace_period=90s. (Reason: sustained p95 > threshold across 3 windows)

sre_jen: +1 to targeted routing. Manual rollback feels heavy given the DB migration last week. We can spin a routing override for embeddings and watch for 10-15m.

maya: If we route, I need to draft a heads-up for dedicated customers that are pinned. I'll prepare a short note and post in #customer-success.

alex: Routing command we use for quick flip is: ```
kubectl patch configmap routing --patch '{"data":{"embeddings_route":"fallback-v1:10%"}}'
```
That will route 10% to fallback; increase to 30% if stable.

oncall-jordi: I'll run the patch now. Alex + SRE, can you watch traces/slow logs for correlating errors after I flip?

ops-bot: routing change initiated by oncall-jordi — embeddings_route=10%->fallback-v1. Request id: req-9f2a.

sre_jen: Seeing initial drop in p95 in the first window (~2m). Keep monitoring. If p95 < 850ms after 2 windows, increment to 30%.

maya: Ticket created for comms: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-12345 — I'll add the dedicated-customer blurb and release note snippet.

oncall-jordi: Agree on escalation plan: if p95 doesn't fall below 900ms within 15m, we consider manual rollback. Otherwise we continue gradual routing for up to 1h and then revert to normal.

alex: Noted. Manual rollback command (if needed): ```
redwoodctl rollout revert --service embeddings --to-version v3.1 --reason "p95 regression" --force
```

deploy-bot: Monitor: embeddings_p95=980ms (window 1), error_rate stable. Auto-rollback suppressed by operator hold.

ops-bot: routing change completed. metrics collection continues.

sre_jen: Copy — escalating to manual rollback if embeddings_p95 >= 1000ms after 15m and error_rate > 1%. Otherwise continue routing.

maya: I'll send the dedicated-customer note once we hit the 30% steady state, include rollback contingency language.

oncall-jordi: Thanks all — oncall will continue watch, I'll post updates every 5m. If anyone needs to takeover, ping me and I'll hand off. :thumbsup:
